title: VICT: Verifier-Instrumented Credit Tracing for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning

rs.key_step: 把terminal verifier拆成可执行/evidence-backed atoms及依赖，只有conformance通过、core内且有proofedge的动作才收credit。
rs.why_non_obvious: 让eligibility由真实verifier接口约束；unsupported时abstain，非按语言相关性强行归因。
rs.trigger_condition: When terminal verifiers expose auditable internal checks, constrain credit routing to dependency-valid atom witnesses.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When terminal verifiers expose auditable internal checks, constrain credit routing to dependency-valid atom witnesses.

signatures.operation: 校验reward重建→按baseadv符号寻找删除/修复core→robustgroup marginals→proofedge分配
signatures.failure_boundary: 只适用于可instrument verifier与可见state；proofeligibility不证明动作因果必要或optimal。

relevance.how: 提供可审计eligibility而非无条件densecredit。
caption/crop缺可验证视觉atoms时不满足前提，不能用prompt rubric替代。
